Consumer: SR_NWN (private), pinned SRN_HAKS `5394878`. Projectile target: sling (SR_NWN decisions D376-D378).

## Load contract

Packs: `srn_weapon`, `srn_2da` (TLK not required). Build only these with `./tools/Build-Haks.ps1 -Pack @('srn_weapon', 'srn_2da') -SkipTlk`. Load srn_weapon with srn_2da for the reviewed Colt L36 multipart contract. HAK archives are ignored build outputs and are not hashed here; resource hashes are the release identity.

## Gaps

| Id | Severity | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| `pinned-commit-lacks-weapons` | blocking-for-consumer | None of the srn_weapon resources, srn_2da/baseitems.2da or the publication manifest exist at the SR_NWN-pinned commit; SR_NWN must advance its SRN_HAKS submodule to consume this slice. |
| `sling-row61-global-display-change` | integration-decision | srn_2da/baseitems.2da changes Sling row 61 ModelType 0->2 and MaxRange 50->52 for the whole Sling family. Ordinary/stock simple-model slings are not client-qualified under this table. |
| `baseitems-full-table-override` | integration-decision | srn_2da ships a complete baseitems.2da. Any SR_NWN or other HAK baseitems change requires an intentional row-level merge; load order is not a substitute. |
| `no-firearm-mechanics` | scope | Colt L36 retains Sling gameplay (damage, range, feats, ammunition). No firearm rules, ammunition items, projectile models or ammunition tables are published; sling projectiles fall back to the installed game. |
| `no-ammunition-assets` | gap-for-sling-target | No sling bullet blueprint, ammunition model/icon, projectile model or ammunitiontypes.2da override exists in any SRN_HAKS pack. The bullets row is carried unchanged. |
| `unpriced-blueprints` | gap-for-combat | All five blueprints have Cost 0 and no item properties; they are builder templates without balance data. Combat stats come only from the base item row. |
| `no-combat-tlk` | info | No combat.* TLK allocations exist (SR_NWN-owned keys: 8, all phenomorpher race strings). The weapon blueprints need no TLK entries; any combat UI/feedback strings SR_NWN needs must be allocated with tools/Allocate-StrRef.ps1. |
| `rights-reference-origin` | rights-review | PROVENANCE.md records operator-supplied references and Pixal3D generation but not the origin/license of the reference images or the generator terms for redistributed outputs. |
| `rights-trademarks` | rights-review | The Colt L36 and Cougar names/branding are third-party marks; PROVENANCE.md explicitly does not assert ownership. GOVERNANCE.md requires trademark review per batch; no recorded clearance. |
| `client-qualification-scope` | qualification | User acceptance covers the shipped Human fixture only; individual animation, armor, glove and off-hand cases and other bodies (c7 lock) were not separately client-tested. |
| `base-game-collision-unchecked` | verify | Weapon resrefs were not compared against an installed NWN:EE key/bif set in this run. |
| `mdrnee-staged-resref-collision` | id-collision | 16 srn_weapon resrefs also exist with different bytes in the staged (quarantined) MDRNEE item HAK; a future MDRNEE promotion must renumber or drop them. |
| `mdrnee-legacy-row61` | id-collision | 10 staged MDRNEE blueprints use legacy BaseItem 61 as a dual-wield handgun; in the EE baseline row 61 is the Sling hosting the Colt L36. |
| `model-range-sr_cfs` | verify | sr_cfs uses model parts [101] outside baseitems row 1 MinRange/MaxRange 10-100.
